# Glossary {#sec-glossary}

::: {.callout-warning title="Stub"}
Filled as chapters are written. Each term links to the chapter that defines it.
:::

| Term | Meaning |
|---|---|
| Lever | One of the four things a data technique can change: representation, sampling distribution $q$, weights $w$, labels |
| Data card | The fixed-field record every technique gets; see [Notation](appendix-notation.qmd#sec-notation) |
| Target distribution $p$ | The distribution the model will face |
| Training distribution $q$ | The distribution training examples are drawn from |
